authorization.scope: One frozen revision of contextual-contribution guidance; targeted checks, mechanism/condition safeguards and a small old-case transfer probe. No component fork or runtime adoption.

hypothesis: Making contextual contribution, redundancy and suggestion necessity explicit may surface missed human concerns without turning useful mechanisms or conditions into defects. This remains a hypothesis.

arms.revised: Same prompt plus guidance.txt before inputs; no other request change

order: Alternating baseline-first and revised-first jobs, fixed before outputs; no after-result swaps

D02-A: Unasked correction: inspect contextual necessity rather than factual truth alone
Repeated ending should be considered in relation to opening
D05-A: Preserve recognition of unnecessary defensive ending
Inspect added contribution of common personal-action sentence
P02-A: Do not treat the evaporation mechanism as filler
P03-B: Do not treat sustained-power condition as filler
D06: Inspect shared framing/metaphor and additional ending using existing human feedback
Preserve useful articulation of both parties' concerns

gates: Review every stage before the next. Stop any transport/schema failure without repair. Stop transfer on a demonstrated material regression that wrongly removes needed mechanism/condition or adds unsupported substantive criticism. Preserve optional suggestions, unresolved necessity and human/model disagreement separately. Do not tune the prompt after any output.

blinding.transfer: Already human-labeled D06; author-visible and used by older judges. Not previously evaluated by current OpenEvals component, not independent holdout.

limits: Selected individual anchor answers, not four complete A/B pairs
No automatic winner or aggregate accuracy
One realization per arm/answer; no stability or statistical superiority claim
Keep prior outputs and costs; historical reports are context, not the fresh baseline
No independent holdout, runtime adoption or prompt revision after seeing results
Provider HTTP request count remains unmeasured
